schema_note: v2.1 climate resilience and carbon account framework responding to the climate/carbon gap. Machine-readable companion of proposal.md section '气候韧性与碳科目框架'. Introduces no new spatial structure; overlays three climate functions onto the existing N-shaped blue-green skeleton. Spatial anchors reference existing layers/sections; all monitoring definitions remain pending baseline.

climate_accounts.spatial_anchor_zh: 滨水绿带雨水花园模块、廊道绿地
climate_accounts.spatial_anchor_en: Rain-garden modules in riverside green belts, corridor green
climate_accounts.mechanism_zh: 分布式海绵设施与防洪评估统筹，结合滨水绿带连通与生态岸线建设
climate_accounts.mechanism_en: Distributed sponge facilities coordinated with flood assessment, tied to waterfront connectivity and ecological shoreline building
climate_accounts.monitoring_definition_zh: 年径流总量控制、汛期验证（衔接滨水绿带监测方向）
climate_accounts.monitoring_definition_en: Annual runoff capture, flood-season verification (aligned with waterfront monitoring)

climate_accounts.spatial_anchor_zh: 绿地率 21.61% 基底、研发院落 500 米见绿
climate_accounts.spatial_anchor_en: 21.61% green-ratio base, research courtyards within 500 m of green
climate_accounts.mechanism_zh: 冷岛廊道与遮荫慢行网络，滨河通风廊道保持开敞
climate_accounts.mechanism_en: Cool-island corridor and shaded slow-mobility network; open riverfront ventilation corridors

climate_accounts.spatial_anchor_zh: 端侧算力节点（边缘算力进公园）、分布式能源点位
climate_accounts.spatial_anchor_en: Edge-compute nodes in parks, distributed energy points
climate_accounts.mechanism_zh: 可再生能源与算力负荷就近平衡，站厅运营节能
climate_accounts.mechanism_en: Renewable energy balanced against local compute load; station-hall energy efficiency

method_discipline_zh: 三科目均为概念建议，不新增空间结构，只在既有蓝绿骨架上叠加气候功能注记；监测口径全部保持待基线，海绵设施规模、防洪标准与碳核算边界待专项深化与官方资料到位后确定，不作数值承诺。与「市政与新型基础设施」节互为一体：本节负责把气候—碳议题落到空间与责任，市政节负责工程与承载力口径。
method_discipline_en: All three accounts are concept proposals introducing no new spatial structure; they overlay climate functions onto the existing blue-green skeleton. Every monitoring definition remains pending baseline; sponge-facility scale, flood-control standards and carbon-accounting boundaries await specialist detailing and official data, with no numeric commitments made. Integral with the Municipal and New Infrastructure section: this section assigns climate-carbon issues to space and responsibility, while the infrastructure section holds the engineering and capacity definitions.
boundary_zh: 全部为概念建议（建议/待深化），不构成政府或专业承诺。
boundary_en: All conceptual proposals pending detailing; not commitments by governments or professionals.
